Article 4 (Application for Authorization to Establish Technical College)
(1) A technical college corporation intending to apply for authorization to establish a technical college under Article 4 (2) of the Higher Education Act shall submit to the Minister of Education, no later than five months before the scheduled opening date specified in the technical college establishment plan, an application for authorization under Article 5 (1) of the Decree together with a report on implementation of the standards under each subparagraph of Article 6 (1) of the Decree. <Amended on February 2, 1999; January 31, 2001; March 4, 2008; March 23, 2013>
(2) A technical college corporation unable to submit the application within the period under paragraph (1) shall submit, within that period, to the Minister of Education an application for extension of authorization together with materials substantiating the reason. The period of extension for submitting the application for authorization shall not exceed three years. <Amended on January 31, 2001; March 4, 2008; March 23, 2013>
